Care that goes beyond the diagnosis.

Whole-Person CareCare that considers your mental, emotional, and overall well-being.›

Thoughtful psychiatric evaluation considers your history, biology, sleep, stress and life context.

Personalized TreatmentEvidence-based treatment tailored to your goals, needs, and lifestyle.›

Family history and pharmacogenetic information may be used as decision aids when appropriate, not as a diagnosis or guarantee of response.

Collaborative PartnershipWe listen first, value your perspective, and build a plan together.›

We discuss options, benefits, side effects and progress together. Your goals guide the plan.

Evidence-Based PracticeThoughtful, up-to-date care guided by clinical research and real-world experience.›

Medication is used when appropriate; supportive counseling and coping tools may complement medication management but do not replace full psychotherapy.

About Micah

Experienced. Compassionate.
Patient-Focused.

Micah provides psychiatric mental health care for adults, with a focus on understanding, respect, and individualized treatment that supports lasting well-being.

Education & Certification

Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner, board certified (PMHNP-BC). Contact the practice for additional credential details.

Clinical Experience

Comprehensive psychiatric evaluation, medication management and individualized treatment planning.

Areas of Focus

Depression, anxiety, ADHD, bipolar spectrum, OCD, trauma-related symptoms, sleep and medication complexity.

Treatment Approach

Direct, warm, collaborative, education-forward and informed by clinical progress.

Partner, don’t dictate.

A CLEAR PATH FORWARD

What care can look like

Choose a step to see what to expect, what we discuss, and how it helps shape your care.

What to expect: A welcoming, judgment-free conversation.

What we discuss: Your experiences, current concerns, health history, and what you’d like to work toward.

The outcome: A shared understanding and an initial care plan.

What to expect: Ongoing check-ins to review progress and adjust care.

What we discuss: Coping skills, medication effects when applicable, and practical strategies for everyday life.

The outcome: A care plan that evolves with your needs.

What to expect: Thoughtful treatment that considers the whole person.

What we discuss: Medication management when appropriate, supportive counseling, sleep and lifestyle strategies.

The outcome: Practical tools and a coordinated approach to care.

What to expect: Regular check-ins with flexible scheduling.

What we discuss: What is working, what feels difficult, and whether adjustments are needed.

The outcome: Care that can become less frequent as appropriate.

What to expect: A plan shaped around your needs and preferences.

What we discuss: Your goals, life circumstances, and treatment options.

The outcome: Shared decisions and adjustments as life changes.

Care begins with a conversation and continues
at a pace that makes sense for you.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Common Questions

Can I ask a question before booking?

Yes. For general questions about services and getting started, call (469) 300-1817 or email the practice. Please do not send private medical information by ordinary email.

Is telehealth available?

Telehealth appointments are offered where the practice is licensed and the service is appropriate. Check availability and eligibility through Headway.

How do I check my insurance?

Use the Headway booking page to explore participating insurance plans and your appointment options.

What should I expect at my first visit?

An initial psychiatric evaluation typically takes 45–60 minutes and focuses on your symptoms, history, prior treatment, and goals. Intake requirements are confirmed through Headway.

Urgent help or an emergency? M.R.-Gen-C Psychiatry does not provide emergency coverage. Call or text 988 for mental health crisis support, or call 911 / go to the nearest emergency department for immediate danger.
M.R.-Gen-C Psychiatry

Services only in licensed states. Privacy practices available upon request. No emergency coverage; call 988 for crisis support or 911 for immediate danger.
